title: 考研核心词汇
subtitle: ECDICT 考研(ky)标签词表，去重后精选（多数考研词已在四六级/VOA 中）

defsEn: n. a government official who conducts criminal prosecutions on behalf of the state
zh: n. 实行者, 告发者, 公诉人
examples: The prosecutor asked me a leading question.
A new prosecutor took over the case from the previous one.
exampleZh: 检察官问了我一个引导性的问题。

defsEn: n. a light truck with an open body and low sides and a tailboard
n. a warrant to take someone into custody
n. anything with restorative powers
zh: n. 拾起, 加速, 刺激, 猎物的收集, 好转, 恢复健康, 搭车者, 兴奋剂, 电视摄像
examples: My bad but could you pickup the car key.
That would make a great pickup line.

defsEn: n. the entrance (the space in a wall) through which you enter or leave a room or building
the space that a door can close
zh: n. 门口, 途径
examples: Her sudden appearance in the doorway surprised us.
The thief hid in the dark doorway.

defsEn: n. a figure of speech in which an expression is used to refer to something that it does not literally denote in order to suggest a similarity
zh: n. 隐喻
examples: Find a metaphor in this text.
The metaphor of death is a metaphor of violence.

defsEn: s. decreed by or proceeding from a court of justice
a. belonging or appropriate to the office of a judge
a. relating to the administration of justice or the function of a judge
zh: a. 法庭的, 公正的, 审判上的, 司法的
examples: The judicial system is slow and complicated.
It's not a judicial reform; it's a judicial takeover.

defsEn: n. the point in time at which something must be completed
zh: n. 最后期限, 截止期限
examples: Who hasn't busted their back on deadline day?
Tom didn't know that the deadline was today.
exampleZh: 谁没有在截稿日拼过命？
汤姆不知道今天是期限。

defsEn: v. cover with blood
a. having or covered with or accompanied by blood
r. extremely
zh: a. 血腥的, 嗜杀的, 有血的
examples: If you drink and drive, you're a bloody idiot.
Who the bloody hell do you think YOU are, mate?

defsEn: n. an adornment (as a bracelet or ring or necklace) made of precious metals and set with gems (or imitation gems)
zh: n. 珠宝, 珠宝类
examples: They broke into the jewelry shop.
She wears a lot of jewelry.
exampleZh: 他们闯进了珠宝店。
她戴很多珠宝。

defsEn: a. of or relating to the doctrine that rejects religion and religious considerations
a. of or relating to clergy not bound by monastic vows
zh: n. 修道院外的教士
a. 世俗的, 现世的, 长期的
examples: I live in a secular country.
Algeria should be a secular country.

defsEn: n. a compartment at the front of a motor vehicle or locomotive where driver sits
n. small two-wheeled horse-drawn carriage
with two seats and a folding hood
n. a car driven by a person whose job is to take passengers where they want to go in exchange for money
zh: n. 出租车, 出租汽车, 出租马车
vi. 乘出租马车(或汽车)
examples: I took a cab to the station.
She went to the museum by cab.
exampleZh: 我搭了计程车到车站。
她搭计程车到博物馆。

defsEn: n. a secret agreement between two or more people to perform an unlawful act
n. a plot to carry out some harmful or illegal act (especially a political plot)
n. a group of conspirators banded together to achieve some harmful or illegal purpose
zh: n. 同谋, 阴谋, 阴谋集团
examples: My friend believes conspiracy theories; should I try to prove him wrong?
I wish this conspiracy you speak of was real, just to spite you.
exampleZh: 我的朋友相信阴谋论，我该试着向他指出他错了吗？

defsEn: n. the bony skeleton of the head of vertebrates
zh: n. 头盖骨, 头脑, 好学生
examples: Tom has a tattoo of a skull on his chest.
He only took off his skull cap in the shower.
exampleZh: 汤姆在胸上有个头骨文身。

defsEn: n. a complex of concurrent things
n. a pattern of symptoms indicative of some disease
zh: n. 并发症状, 综合征, 同时存在的事物
examples: I have a child with Down syndrome.
She was born with Down syndrome.

defsEn: n. a narrow channel or strait
v. empty completely
destroy the inside of
v. remove the guts of
zh: n. 剧情, 内容, 内脏, 肚子, 海峡, 勇气
vt. 取出内脏, 毁坏...的内部
examples: He doesn't have the guts to say no to my plan.
You've got a lot of guts.
exampleZh: 他没那个胆拒绝我的提议。
你胆子很大。

defsEn: n. a narcotic (alkaloid) extracted from coca leaves
used as a surface anesthetic or taken for pleasure
can become powerfully addictive
zh: n. 可卡因, 古柯碱
examples: Do you use cocaine or crack?
I thought that it might be cocaine, but it was only flour.

defsEn: n. any cohesive unit such as a military company
n. a set of clothing (with accessories)
zh: n. 用具, 配备, 机构
vt. 配备, 供应
vi. 得到装备
examples: Your outfit today is so gorgeous!
Do you have an outfit to wear to the dance?
exampleZh: 你今天穿得非常漂亮啊！

defsEn: n. worthless people
v. dispose of (something useless or old)
zh: n. 垃圾, 废物
vt. 丢弃
examples: There's a lot of trash on the far bank of the river.
They fine you in Singapore if you throw trash in the streets.
exampleZh: 河对岸有很多的垃圾。
在新加坡的街道上扔垃圾会被罚款。

defsEn: n. the arch of hair above each eye
zh: n. 眉毛
examples: Xiaolin's eyebrows are thick, his eyes are big, and his eyelashes are long.
Kobayashi's eyebrows are thick, his eyes are big, and his eyelashes are long.
exampleZh: 小林的眉毛长得浓，眼睛又大，睫毛很长。
小林的眉毛长得浓，眼睛又大，睫毛很长。

defsEn: s. coming to maturity
zh: 出现的, 发生的, 形成的
examples: What do you think of emerging markets like Turkey?
Yanni saw a figure emerging from the forest.

defsEn: n. a long narrow passage (as in a cave or woods)
n. passageway between seating areas as in an auditorium or passenger vehicle or between areas of shelves of goods as in stores
n. part of a church divided laterally from the nave proper by rows of pillars or columns
zh: n. 走廊, 侧廊, 过道
examples: Would you like a window or aisle seat?
I'd like an aisle seat, please.
exampleZh: 你想靠窗还是走廊？
请给我靠走道的位子。

defsEn: n acting according to certain accepted standards
n a disposition or tendency to yield to the will of others
n the act of submitting
usually surrendering power to another
zh: n. 遵从, 顺从, 屈从
examples: We are building your house in compliance with your wishes.
The factory was not in compliance with safety regulations.

defsEn: n. a tract of land used for burials
zh: n. 墓地, 公墓
examples: J.F. Kennedy was buried in Arlington Cemetery.
I used to walk in the cemetery in my youth.
exampleZh: 约翰甘迺迪被安葬在阿灵顿公墓。

defsEn: n. a feeling of intense annoyance caused by being tormented
n. the act of tormenting by continued persistent attacks and criticism
zh: n. 困扰, 烦扰, 烦恼
examples: Sexual harassment can be a serious problem in the workplace.
Sexual harassment has now become a social issue.

defsEn: n. a fee levied for the use of roads or bridges (used for maintenance)
v. ring slowly
v. charge a fee for using
zh: n. 通行费, 代价, 钟声
vt. 征收, 敲钟, 鸣钟, 勾引, 引诱
vi. 征税, 鸣钟
examples: We must pay a toll to drive on this road.
The death toll from the attack remains unknown and controversial.
exampleZh: 我们必得缴通行税才能在这条道路上行驶。

defsEn: n. underground pod of the peanut vine
n. widely cultivated American plant cultivated in tropical and warm regions
showy yellow flowers on stalks that bend over to the soil so that seed pods ripen underground
n. a young child who is small for his age
n. pod of the peanut vine containing usually 2 nuts or seeds
`groundnut' and `monkey nut' are British terms
zh: n. 花生, 小人物, 极小的数额
a. 渺小的, 微不足道的
examples: Peanut allergy is the most common of food allergies.
He told us he couldn't eat peanuts.
exampleZh: 花生过敏是最常见的食物过敏。
他跟我们说他不能吃花生。

defsEn: n. a variety of bridge in which tricks made in excess of the contract are scored toward game
now generally superseded by contract bridge
n. the public sale of something to the highest bidder
v. sell at an auction
zh: n. 拍卖
vt. 拍卖
examples: The unclaimed items were sold off at auction.
The unclaimed items were sold at auction.
exampleZh: 无人领取的物品被拍卖了。
无人领取的物品被拍卖了。

defsEn: n. the quality or state of being mortal
zh: n. 必死的命运, 死亡数目, 死亡率
examples: The mortality curve is climbing upwards.
Is there something beyond both mortality and immortality? Are the two just mutually exclusive?

defsEn: v select as an alternative over another
zh: vi. 选择
examples: You can opt out if you like.
We decided to opt for a more cost-effective alternative for the project.

defsEn: n. immunity from arbitrary exercise of authority: political independence
n. personal independence
zh: n. 自治, 自治权
examples: I respect people's autonomy and choose not to interfere in their personal matters.
How much of your own autonomy are you ceding to these people?

defsEn: n. a musical composition of several movements only loosely connected
n. apartment consisting of a series of connected rooms used as a living unit (as in a hotel)
n. a matching set of furniture
zh: n. 随员, 套房, (一)组, (一)套, 组曲, 继之而来的事
examples: Pietro went through the entire suite and found nothing.
I booked a suite in a swanky hotel.

defsEn: a. of or relating to or concerning theology
zh: a. 神学上的
examples: The Jewish Theological Seminary in New York City ordains Conservative rabbis.

defsEn: n sound recording consisting of a disk with a continuous groove
used to reproduce music by rotating while a phonograph needle tracks in the groove
n something with a round shape resembling a flat circular plate
n (computer science) a memory device consisting of a flat disk covered with a magnetic coating on which information is stored
n a flat circular plate
zh: n. 圆盘, 唱片
vt. 灌唱片
examples: She gave me this compact disc.
Compact discs have entirely taken the place of phonograph records.
exampleZh: 她给了我这个光碟。
CD已经完全取代了胶木唱片。

defsEn: n. a woman who has recently been married
n. a woman participant in her own marriage ceremony
zh: n. 新娘
examples: The bride seems to be very pretty.
According to custom, the bride should be compliant.
exampleZh: 新娘好像非常漂亮。
根据习俗，新娘应该循规蹈矩。

defsEn: n. an account of the series of events making up a person's life
zh: n. 传记
examples: He was writing a biography of a famous poet.
He wrote a biography of a famous poet.

defsEn: s. driving or forcing
s. tending to persuade by forcefulness of argument
zh: a. 强制的, 强迫性的, 激发兴趣的
examples: Green towns enhance your well-being, compelling you to give back.
His argument was compelling, but it failed to convince the majority.

defsEn: n. a small sharp-pointed tip resembling a spike on a stem or leaf
n. the part of a book's cover that encloses the inner side of the book's pages and that faces outward when the book is shelved
n. a sharp rigid animal process or appendage
as a porcupine quill or a ridge on a bone or a ray of a fish fin
zh: n. 背骨, 脊柱, 尖刺
examples: A chill ran down his spine as he crossed the park.
I felt a shiver run down my spine.
exampleZh: 他穿过公园时，一阵寒意顺着脊背蔓延而下。

defsEn: n. a deep awareness of and sympathy for another's suffering
n. the humane quality of understanding the suffering of others and wanting to do something about it
zh: n. 同情, 怜悯
examples: You have to show compassion to your girl.
Compassion you get as a gift. Envy you have to work hard for.

defsEn: n. a fastener that locks or closes
zh: n. 抽屉, 小柜, 上锁人
examples: The players sat in the locker room while they listened to their coach speak.
Jayjay ran into John in the locker room.
exampleZh: 球员们坐在更衣室里听教练讲话。
杰杰在更衣室碰到了约翰。

defsEn: n the combination of two or more commercial companies
n an occurrence that involves the production of a union
zh: n. 合并, 归并
examples: The news of the merger of the two companies broke yesterday.
The office has been topsy-turvy since the merger upset everything.
exampleZh: 昨天突然传出了两间公司合并的消息。
自从公司合并了以后，一切都变得十分混乱。

defsEn: s. causing great astonishment and consternation
s. causing or capable of causing bewilderment or shock or insensibility
s. strikingly beautiful or attractive
zh: a. 打昏迷的, 弄得人昏头昏脑的, 令人震惊的
examples: The mountain cabin had a stunning view of the valley below.
You and your brother look the same. That's stunning!

defsEn: n. an informal conversation
zh: n. 闲谈
vi. 闲谈, 聊天
examples: Tom, I want to have a chat with you.
Cut the chit-chat and get to work.
exampleZh: Tom，我想和你谈谈。
别闲聊了，工作去。

defsEn: v. conduct a prosecution in a court of law
v. bring a criminal action against (in a trial)
v. carry out or participate in an activity
be involved in
zh: vt. 告发, 起诉, 彻底进行, 执行, 从事
vi. 告发, 起诉, 作检察官
examples: He will be prosecuted to the full extent of the law.
This is enough for them to prosecute me.

defsEn: n. an economic system based on private ownership of capital
zh: n. 资本主义
examples: Capitalism will cut down the tree if it can't sell its shadow.
Of course under capitalism you can buy and sell anything, even pollution.

defsEn: n. a written proposal or reminder
zh: n. 备忘录
examples: I put a memo on my calendar.
The company sent out a memo with an apology for the mistake.

defsEn: v. join the military
v. engage somebody to enter the army
zh: vt. 征募, 参与, 谋取
vi. 从军, 应募, 赞助
examples: I need to enlist your help.
I enlisted in the Space Force.

defsEn: n. a young person, not fully developed
a. of or relating to or characteristic of or appropriate for children or young people
zh: n. 少年, 少年读物
a. 少年的, 不成熟的, 适于少年的
examples: Juvenile crimes have been increasing recently.
Juvenile delinquency is on the increase at a rapid pace.
exampleZh: 少年犯罪最近一直在增长。

defsEn: a. of or relating to or characteristic of comedy
zh: n. 连环漫画, 喜剧演员, 滑稽的人
a. 滑稽的, 有趣的, 喜剧的
examples: I borrowed this comic from his sister.
I found the comic book very interesting.
exampleZh: 我向他的妹妹借了这个漫画。
我发现这本漫画书非常有趣。

defsEn: n. qualities that attract by seeming to promise some kind of reward
zh: n. 饵, 诱惑
vt. 引诱, 诱惑
examples: You have to lure the cat out from under the bed.
I could not resist the lure of great profits.

defsEn: n. a textile machine for weaving yarn into a textile
v. come into view indistinctly, often threateningly
v. appear very large or occupy a commanding position
v. weave on a loom
zh: n. 织布机, 若隐若现的景象
vi. 朦胧地出现, 隐约可见, 可怕地出现
examples: The fear of failure looms over me.
The conductor loomed over me and asked severely: "Are you, by chance, a rabbit?"

defsEn: n. a being (usually female) imagined to have special powers derived from the devil
zh: n. 巫婆, 女巫
vt. 施巫术, 迷惑
examples: Mary dressed up as a witch.
The witch cast a spell on the naughty boy.
exampleZh: 玛丽打扮成一个女巫。

defsEn: n. an image that is generated by a computer
s. written or drawn or engraved
s. describing nudity or sexual activity in graphic detail
a. of or relating to the graphic arts
zh: a. 生动的, 轮廓分明的, 绘画似的, 图解的
examples: You will need a graphic card to play this game.
You will need a graphics card to play this game.

defsEn: n. a white sparkling wine either produced in Champagne or resembling that produced there
n. a region of northeastern France
zh: n. 香槟酒, 香槟酒色
examples: Instead of drinking cola, why not drink champagne?
This politician is a typical champagne socialist.
exampleZh: 与其喝可乐，倒不如喝香槟。
这个政客是典型的香槟社会主义者。

defsEn: n the arrangement of the body and its limbs
n characteristic way of bearing one's body
n a rationalized mental attitude
n capability in terms of personnel and materiel that affect the capacity to fight a war
v behave affectedly or unnaturally in order to impress others
v assume a posture as for artistic purposes
zh: n. 姿势, 态度, 情形, 形势
vt. 作...的姿势
vi. 作姿势
examples: Change your posture and the confidence will come.
Our cats have the posture of a tiger or a lion.

defsEn: n. a holding device
n. a person who holds something
n. the person who is in possession of a check or note or bond or document of title that is endorsed to him or to whoever holds it
zh: n. 持有人, 所有人, 支持物
examples: The oar fell out of its holder.
There's a paper towel holder next to the sink.

defsEn: n. free from obscurity and easy to understand
the comprehensibility of clear expression
zh: n. 清楚, 明晰
examples: I find clarity in the quiet of dawn.
I lack clarity on what I want to achieve in life.

defsEn: s. characterized by often poignant difference or incongruity between what is expected and what actually is
zh: a. 冷嘲的, 挖苦的, 反话的, 讽刺的, 令人啼笑皆非的, 出乎意料的
examples: Is he being serious or ironic?
I'm not sure if this is ironic or not.

defsEn: n. a methodical examination or review of a condition or situation
v. examine carefully for accuracy with the intent of verification
v. attend academic courses without getting credit
zh: n. 审计, 查帐
vt. 查(帐), 旁听
vi. 查账
examples: This financial audit also includes an evaluation of the company's assets.
Did they conduct a cybersecurity audit recently?

defsEn: n. a white metallic element that burns with a brilliant light
the fifth most abundant element in the earth's crust
an important component of most plants and animals
zh: n. 钙
examples: Calcium is an essential mineral for the human body.
Calcium is absent from his diet.

defsEn: n. a small drink
v. drink in sips
zh: n. 啜饮, 小口喝, 抿
vi. 啜饮
vt. 啜
examples: He savored a sip of coffee.
He sipped the hot coffee slowly.
exampleZh: 他细细地品了一口咖啡。
他慢慢地啜饮热咖啡。

defsEn: s. extremely pleasing
s. based on or told of in traditional stories
lacking factual basis or historical validity
s. barely credible
zh: a. 传说的, 寓言般的, 难以置信的
examples: It was a fabulous show which brought us an endless delight.
The unicorn is a fabulous monster.
exampleZh: 那是一个给我们带来无穷乐趣的传奇性的演出。
独角兽是一种美丽的怪物。

defsEn: n. machines or machine systems collectively
n. a system of means and activities whereby a social institution functions
zh: n. 机器, 机械装置, 机构
examples: Something must be wrong with the machinery.
What kind of farm machinery do you need to buy?
exampleZh: 这个机器一定有什么地方不对劲。

defsEn: v. remove from memory or existence
v. remove by or as if by rubbing or erasing
v. wipe out digitally or magnetically recorded information
zh: vt. 抹去, 擦掉
examples: He erased his speech from the tape.
I erased the blackboard for the teacher.
exampleZh: 他把他的那段话从磁带里删除了。
我为老师擦黑板。

defsEn: n. thinking that is coherent and logical
zh: n. 推论, 推理, 论证
examples: Do you think reasoning with him would do some good?
Your argument should have a line of reasoning.

defsEn: n an area wholly or partly surrounded by walls or buildings
zh: n. 庭院, 天井
examples: Chase that duck out of the courtyard.
In the castle courtyard he saw the horses sleep.

defsEn: n. that part of the earnings of a corporation that is distributed to its shareholders
usually paid quarterly
n. a number to be divided by another number
n. a bonus
something extra (especially a share of a surplus)
zh: n. 被除数, 股利

defsEn: n. a narcotic that is considered a hard drug
a highly addictive morphine derivative
intravenous injection provides the fastest and most intense rush
zh: n. 海洛因, 吗啡
examples: Heroin isn't a good thing. Stay away from it!
I used to be a heroin addict.
exampleZh: 白粉可不是好东西，离它远一点！

defsEn: n. a portable computer small enough to use in your lap
zh: 膝上型的
examples: I need to buy a gaming laptop.
This laptop is thin and light.
exampleZh: 我需要买一个游戏笔记本。
这个笔记本电脑又薄又轻。

defsEn: n. a Christian celebration of the Resurrection of Christ
celebrated on the Sunday following the first full moon after the vernal equinox
zh: n. 复活节
examples: I found an Easter egg during Easter.
I celebrate Easter with my family.

defsEn: n. a second-year undergraduate
s. used of the second year in United States high school or college
zh: n. (大学)二年级生
a. 二年级学生的, 二年级的
examples: Sami was a sophomore at that high school.
This all happened in sophomore year of high school.
exampleZh: 萨米当时是那所高中的二年级学生。

defsEn: n. someone who maintains and audits business accounts
zh: n. 会计人员, 会计师
examples: I have an accountant to do that.
I need to hire an accountant.

defsEn: n. a blood vessel that carries blood from the heart to the body
n. a major thoroughfare that bears important traffic
zh: n. 动脉, 干道, 要道
examples: Be careful not to nick an artery.
The arteries transport oxygen-rich blood from the heart to the tissues.

defsEn: n. a workplace where fish are caught and processed and sold
zh: n. 渔业
examples: The fishery remained empty and devoid of fish for many centuries.
How much is Algeria's fishery sector worth?

defsEn: v. attach to, as a journalist to a military unit when reporting on a war
zh: vt. 使插入, 使嵌入, 使深留脑中
examples: How can I embed the debt clock on my Web site?
I wish I could figure out how to embed a YouTube video.

defsEn: n. a colorless gas (O3) soluble in alkalis and cold water
a strong oxidizing agent
can be produced by electric discharge in oxygen or by the action of ultraviolet radiation on oxygen in the stratosphere (where it acts as a screen for ultraviolet radiation)
zh: n. 新鲜的空气, 臭氧, 使人愉快的影响
examples: The ozone in the stratosphere absorbs ultraviolet radiation.
Without the ozone layer, we would be in danger.
exampleZh: 平流层的臭氧会吸收紫外线。

defsEn: n. something that is regarded as a chance event
n. players buy (or are given) chances and prizes are distributed by casting lots
zh: n. 奖券, 彩票, 运气
examples: If I win the lottery, I'll be able to live high on the hog.
If I won the lottery, I'd buy a new car.
exampleZh: 如果我中了彩劵，就一辈子衣食无忧了。
如果我中了彩票，我会买辆新车。

defsEn: n. a periodic count of the population
v. conduct a census
zh: n. 户口普查
vt. 实施统计调查
examples: In the United States, a census takes place every ten years.
In the United States, there is a census every ten years.

defsEn: n. a prescribed number
n. a proportional share assigned to each participant
n. a limitation on imports
zh: n. 配额, 限额
examples: How can I meet this quota?
I failed to meet my quota today.

defsEn: n. a passage selected from a larger work
v. take out of a literary work in order to cite or copy
zh: n. 摘录
